caption:
SATB Telemetry & Harness Audit — 12/12 C1–C12 checks across 5 hosts · 32.6%–89.9% CPU-proportional attribution error exposed (Thor measured_j & 4 reported_j hosts)

Across 5 hosts (Jetson AGX Thor TI INA238/INA3221 DC shunts + 4 counter hosts), the Rust SATB harness passed 12/12 replay checks while exposing 32.59%-89.88% Kepler CPU-splitting errors.

• Provenance: Signed Provenance · Self-Checked (not externally peer-reviewed; studio voice is_aigc=true)
• Telemetry: measured_j (Jetson AGX Thor TI INA238/INA3221 DC shunts (measured_j) kept strictly separate from 4 reported_j hosts; L0 AC wall meter unattached.)
• Essay: https://blog.openie.dev/posts/satb-harness/
• Paper: https://research.openie.dev/papers/satb-harness/
• Replicate: https://github.com/openIE-dev/openie-research-experiments/tree/main/replicate
